Pushes a program definition: a new name creates the program, a known one gets a new
version. The version is a draft unless --publish, which also moves alias latest.

Usage:
  kaab programs push FILE.json [flags]

Flags:
      --description string   a new program's description
  -h, --help                 help for push
      --name string          the program's name (the definition's by default)
      --notes string         notes on the new version
      --publish              publish the version (moves alias latest)

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)
